run_camera_optimization: run the pulsar camera parameter optimization example that converges distorted camera params to a reference image
create_scene_model: create a SceneModel nn.Module with parameterized point cloud positions, colors, radii, and camera parameters for pulsar rendering
render_pointcloud_with_pulsar: render a Pointclouds object using PulsarPointsRenderer with configurable gamma, zfar, znear, and background color
optimize_camera_parameters: optimize camera position, rotation, and focal length using SGD to minimize MSE loss against a reference image
review_scenemodel_forward: review the SceneModel forward method that creates Pointclouds and renders them through the PulsarPointsRenderer pipeline
